C1163.title: Berlin Data Protection Commissioner Notifies Apple and Google to Review DeepSeek App Removal
C1163.summary: On June 27, 2025, the Berlin Commissioner for Data Protection and Freedom of Information announced that it had notified Apple and Google in Germany under Article 16 of the Digital Services Act that the DeepSeek app constituted illegal content. The authority said the platforms must review the notice promptly and decide whether to block the app in Germany, citing unlawful transfers and storage of German users' personal data in China without an EU adequacy decision or appropriate safeguards under the GDPR.
